terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms that apply to the {brand_name} website and to the purchase of the e-book.

p: This website (ethiopian-codex.com) sells {brand_name}, an independent educational e-book about the books of the Ethiopian Orthodox Bible. In these terms, "we" means the publisher of {brand_name} and "you" means anyone who visits the site or buys the product. Contact: {support_email}.

By using this site you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site. You agree not to misuse the site, for example by sending automated requests to the free-preview form or trying to break its security.

Payments are processed by Hotmart, which acts as the payment platform and reseller. When you buy, you also accept Hotmart's terms of purchase and privacy policy. The price shown on the page is the price charged at checkout; taxes, currency conversion and card fees depend on your country and payment method and are shown by Hotmart before you pay.
After payment is confirmed, Hotmart gives you access to the product. If you do not receive access, write to us or contact Hotmart support.

You can ask for a full refund within 7 days of purchase, for any reason. Request it through Hotmart (in the purchase confirmation email or at Hotmart's help center) or write to {support_email}. After a refund, access to the product ends.

The e-book is for your personal, non-commercial use. You may read it on your own devices and print it for yourself. You may not resell, share, upload or distribute it, in whole or in part, without our written permission. Short quotations with credit, for review or study, are welcome.
The ancient texts quoted in the book are taken from public-domain translations, which remain free for everyone. Our commentary, structure, design and translations are protected by copyright.
The free preview sent by email is a sample of the book for your personal use. The same licence rules apply to it.

{brand_name} is an independent educational guide based on public-domain translations and published scholarship. It is not an official publication of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church or any other church, and it is not religious, legal or professional advice. Scholars disagree on many of these topics; the book cites its sources so you can check them. This site is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

We work to keep the content accurate, but we provide the site and the e-book "as is". To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses arising from their use. Our total liability for a purchase is limited to the amount you paid. Nothing in these terms limits rights that consumer law in your country gives you and that cannot be waived.
We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version. Changes do not affect purchases already made.
Questions about these terms or your purchase: {support_email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What personal data the {brand_name} website collects, why, and how to control it.

p: We collect very little: your email address if you ask for the free preview, and the technical data any website receives. We do not sell your data. You can ask us to delete it at any time by writing to {support_email}.
The publisher of {brand_name} is responsible for the data collected on ethiopian-codex.com. Contact for any privacy request: {support_email}.

Free preview form: your email address, the language you chose (English or Spanish) and your consent. We use them to send you the free preview and, as the form says, occasional notes about the book. The legal basis is your consent.

Technical data: when you visit the site, our hosting provider receives your IP address, browser type and the pages requested, and keeps them in short-lived logs for security and to keep the site running. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in operating a secure site.

Purchases: payment is handled entirely by Hotmart. We do not see or store your card details. Hotmart shares with us the information needed to deliver the product and provide support (such as your name and email). Hotmart's own privacy policy applies to the data you give them.
Links: buttons may carry campaign tags (such as src or utm_) to the checkout so we know which video or page brought a sale. These tags do not identify you personally.

This site does not set its own cookies and does not use advertising or analytics trackers. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which means your browser connects to Google and shares your IP address with it. If we ever add analytics or advertising pixels, we will update this policy and ask for consent where the law requires it. The Hotmart checkout uses its own cookies, described in Hotmart's policy.

sections.h: 5. Who processes your data for us
p: Resend sends our emails and stores the related records (address, sending logs). Vercel hosts the site. Hotmart processes payments. Google Fonts serves the typefaces. These providers may process data outside your country, including in the United States and Brazil, under their own security and data-transfer safeguards.

We keep your email address until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it. Server logs are kept only for a short period by the hosting provider. Purchase records are kept for as long as tax and accounting laws require.

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR in Europe or the LGPD in Brazil), you can ask to access, correct, export or delete your data, withdraw your consent, or object to its use. Write to {support_email} and we will reply within 15 days. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.
To stop receiving emails from us, write to the same address with the word "unsubscribe".
This site is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data.
We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the latest version.
